prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories: adoption redesigns, adoption wait_info, choose_path hints, finish layout/redesign, home new_flow, and sign-in reordering.
Home wait_info changes are helpful, supported by 2 winning tests out of 5.
Choose_path redesigns (2 tests) and choose_path copy updates (2 tests) showed no clear positive effect, ranging from no effect to worse.
Adoption hints (3 tests), home redesigns (2 tests), sign-in copy updates (2 tests), and sign-in incentives (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Finish hints (2 tests) and sign-in notifications (2 tests) showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Predictions were consistently too low for winning changes and too high for changes that had no clear effect or performed worse.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Trait Synthesis Progress Display: Displays detailed pet personality trait synthesis progress checklist while waiting on pet generation. (why: Home wait_info changes have a proven record of success (2 winning tests out of 5), and home adoption waiting takes a median of 201s.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Pet Voice and Command Control Guided Flow: Rebuilds the home intro into an interactive guided multi-step flow showing how to speak to and command the pet on the desktop. (why: Users reported confusion after onboarding on how to interact with and control their desktop companion.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign-In Account Safety Protection Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen to prominently feature an account pet persistence checklist assuring users their pet will not be reset upon sign-in. (why: Support received 8 emails last week specifically regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Habitat Background Audio Wait Info: Adds ambient pet sound toggle and audio feedback options on the waiting screen while files download. (why: Home wait_info improvements consistently help retain users during long render waits (median 201s).)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Desktop System Notification: Adds an opt-in system notification trigger on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app and get notified when the pet is ready. (why: Mean waiting step time is high (2336s), leading users to leave the app unattended during adoption generation.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Control Recall & Hide Hint: Adds a clear hint banner explaining taskbar tray controls and hide/show hotkeys on the home intro screen. (why: Directly addresses support complaints where users are unclear how to control or hide their pet.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Pet Anti-Reset Assurance Copy: Updates headline and body text on the sign-in screen to emphasize cloud save protection against pet data resets. (why: Addresses 8 support tickets from users whose pets were reset or lost when signing in.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Centered Minimalist Layout: Updates the choose_path screen layout to a centered layout focused on clear story options. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating users get stuck or confused during path choice.)

scores.note: Home wait_info changes have strong confidence from 2 winning tests, targeting high median wait time.

Low cost wait_info change supported by positive historical track record on home wait screens.
Notifications in earlier tests showed negative lift (-3.3%), making this approach risky.
Low cost, but finish hints consistently performed worse in past tests (-4.1% average).
